AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Aircraft Structures, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Structures.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Structures.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Structures.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Structures.

2. When learning Airfield Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Airfield Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Airfield Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Airfield Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Airfield Safety.

3. When learning Hangar Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Hangar Safety.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Hangar Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Hangar Safety.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Hangar Safety.

4. When learning Terminal Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Terminal Operations.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Terminal Operations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Terminal Operations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Terminal Operations.

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Information and Communication Technology
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Input Cable Tester

6. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

7. When learning Flight Instruments, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Instruments.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Instruments.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Instruments.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Instruments.

8. When learning Navigation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Navigation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Navigation.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Navigation.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Navigation.

9. When learning Aircraft Propulsion, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Propulsion.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Propulsion.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Propulsion.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Propulsion.

10. When learning Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection.

11. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Remove all guards

12. When learning Ramp services, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ramp services.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Ramp services.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ramp services.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ramp services.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Propulsion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Controls and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Flight Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
